# Dropdon

Dungeon and raid loot for World of Warcraft: Forever: every instance with its bosses and what they drop, filtered to what you can use.
Download: https://www.curseforge.com/projects/1782347

The full description (German) is in [README.md](../README.md). Loot data from All The Things (MIT). Bug reports are welcome as issues,
please add the text of `/dd diag`.
